question: Panchpatmali deposits in Koraput district are the deposits of which of the following minerals?
solution:
***The correct answer is Bauxite.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Panchpatmali deposits in Koraput district are known for their abundant reserves of bauxite, which is the primary ore used to produce aluminum.
 
• Bauxite is a sedimentary rock that typically contains high levels of aluminum hydroxide minerals, as well as other impurities like iron oxides and silica.
 
• Panchpatmali deposits in Koraput district is located in Orissa.
 
• Bauxite deposits are created when rocks containing a lot of aluminum silicates break down.
 
• Panchpatmali deposits is the largest bauxite mines in Asia.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Iron ore is another mineral commonly found in India and is used primarily in the production of steel. 
 
• Copper is a metal that is used in a variety of applications, from electrical wiring to plumbing. 
 
• Manganese is a metal that is used primarily in the production of steel and other alloys. 
 
• Bauxite is the primary source of gallium and aluminum in the world.
